items.headline: Saints, Cowboys scuffle in joint practice
items.summary: Tuesday's joint practice with the Cowboys in Oxnard got chippy, with several scuffles breaking out. Coach Kellen Moore said the team still got the work it needed done.

items.headline: Trey'Dez Green named to Walter Camp watch list
items.summary: The junior tight end is the only tight end on the 50-player list for national player of the year. He already holds LSU's career record for receiving touchdowns by a tight end.

items.headline: LSU ranked No. 11 in preseason AP poll
items.summary: The Tigers open the season Sept. 5 at home against Clemson, who did not make the poll. It is LSU's first season under new coach Lane Kiffin.
